description: This plot compares the performance of different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) models, as measured by MRR@10, across a range of queries used during inference (S), showing the relationship between the number of queries and the retrieval performance for various DPR configurations. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, labeled as "Number of queries used during inference (S)", with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the MRR@10 metric, with a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different DPR configuration: "DPR w/o query" is shown as a black solid line, remaining constant at approximately 34.3 across the x-axis; "DPR w/ corpus expansion" is depicted as a red line with circular markers and a solid style, starting at 35.5 and increasing to 35.7 as the number of queries increases from 1 to 10; "DPR w/ document expansion" is represented by a green line with triangular markers and a solid style, beginning at 34.7 and remaining relatively stable around 35.0; "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" is illustrated as a blue line with star-shaped markers and a solid style, starting at 34.7, peaking at 35.1 at S=3, and then decreasing to 34.3 at S=10.
